what: Pinned stage: the video/photo panel opens as a spearhead shape stretching from one corner (default bottom right) toward the opposite corner. The tip extends diagonally by progress × 1.8, the two edges attached to the corner open by a .01 to 1 share, and the line joining the tip and the two edges is a quadratic curve with its middle pulled .2 toward the corner, so it bends like a blade (no easing curve, tied directly to scroll).

duration.Scroll: From when the top edge of the track touches the top of the screen until its bottom edge touches the bottom of the screen (change with start·end)

options.direction: Opening side br-tl (default · bottom right → top left)·bl-tr·tr-bl·tl-br
options.curve: Ratio that pulls the middle of each edge toward the corner, default .2 (Brand value — the original part’s default is .1). At 0 it is a straight spear tip
options.reach: Multiplier the endpoint extends, default 1.8 — at 1 it stops at the diagonal end
options.from: Start share of opening at the middle of progress, default 0 — Brand uses .1 of the first cell in the last section

note: The caller attaches the panel with sticky (the track must be longer than the screen to have a range). The original edited the path d of an SVG clipPath, and the part draws the same shape with CSS clip-path: path()

from.where: index.html .spiral (last section) — index.js scene 6 spear(): original maskSpear({ direction: 'br-tl', curve: 0.2 }), progress is the .1~1 share of the last section’s in slot (2000px)
